summary: Frontend-only validation of P5 (MakerReviews on /makers/iron-and-oak), P6 (Admin Digests tab), P8 (AdminDashboard refactor smoke), P9 (Esc + focus-trap on ModerationConfirmModal). 1 CRITICAL bug found in P5 review-submit flow (backend rejects null location → frontend renders error object as React child causing runtime crash). P6 + P8 verified clean. P9 Esc/aria attributes pass; focus-trap wrap behavior could not be conclusively verified by Playwright.

critical.issue: ReviewCreate.location is `str = ""` (non-Optional). Frontend MakerReviews sends `location: null` when empty, triggering 422 Pydantic validation error. Either change schema to `location: Optional[str] = ""` (and coerce None→"") OR make the frontend send empty string.

ui_bugs.issue:
When backend returns 422 with FastAPI's structured detail array (list of {type, loc, msg, input, url} dicts), the component sets `setErr(detail)` and renders `{err}` directly inside

— React crashes with 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, url})'. Fix: stringify or take only the first .msg / always coerce to string before setErr.

integration_issues.issue: Happy-path submit fails because frontend sends `location: form.location.trim() || null` (null) but backend ReviewCreate requires str. Combined with the React-child crash above, the entire app crashes after clicking Post Review when location field is left blank. Either coerce to '' on the frontend OR relax backend schema.

action_items: P5 CRITICAL: Fix POST /api/reviews ↔ MakerReviews payload mismatch — change MakerReviews.jsx onSubmit to send `location: form.location.trim()` (empty string instead of null) OR change backend ReviewCreate to `location: Optional[str] = ""` and coerce None.

P5 CRITICAL: In MakerReviews onSubmit catch, never assign a non-string to setErr — use `String(e?.response?.data?.detail || ...)` or extract `.msg` from the first element if it's an array. This prevents the React-child runtime crash that currently masks any backend validation error.

P9 (info): Manually re-verify focus trap (Tab from last → first, Shift+Tab from first → last) with a real keyboard — Playwright's programmatic focus + dispatched Tab did not show wrap-around in our automation, but Esc and aria attributes are confirmed working.

DOC: review_request testid list is slightly off — actual admin tab ids are `admin-tab-web`, `admin-tab-makers`, `admin-tab-custom`, `admin-tab-orders` (not `-web-analytics/-maker-analytics/-custom-orders/-paid-orders`). All 10 tabs do render.
critical_code_review_comments: MakerReviews.jsx line 109: `location: form.location.trim() || null` is the root cause of the 422. Either remove the `|| null` fallback or wrap the value in a presence check before sending.

MakerReviews.jsx line 118: `setErr(e?.response?.data?.detail || "Failed to submit review. Please try again.")` — when FastAPI returns 422, `detail` is an ARRAY of dicts, not a string. Always coerce: `setErr(typeof d === 'string' ? d : (Array.isArray(d) ? d[0]?.msg : 'Failed…'))`.
MakerReviews.jsx onSubmit never resets `submitted=false` automatically — only via the 'Write another' button. Acceptable UX but worth confirming intentional.
DigestsTab.jsx confirm-modal does NOT have Esc-key dismiss or focus-trap — the spec only required them on ModerationConfirmModal, but for a11y consistency consider adding them here too.

AdminDashboard.jsx still ~1090 lines after extraction (down from 1614). Recommend further splitting analytics tabs (web/maker/listings/reviews/applications/custom/orders) into /components/admin/* per the >700 LOC rule.

success_rate.frontend: P5: 67% (4/6 — submit broken), P6: 100%, P8: 100%, P9: 75% (Esc + ARIA pass, Tab-trap inconclusive)

All 10 admin tabs render: admin-tab-{analytics, web, makers, applications, custom, orders, listings, users, reviews, digests}. P9 Esc and aria-modal='true' / role='dialog' confirmed.
rca_of_the_issue:
P5 review-submit crash RCA: (1) MakerReviews.jsx:109 sends `location: form.location.trim() || null` — null when blank. (2) Backend models.py:137 declares `ReviewCreate.location: str = ""` — non-Optional, rejects null with 422 + FastAPI-shaped detail array `[{type, loc, msg, input, url}]`. (3) MakerReviews.jsx:118 catch assigns `e.response.data.detail` (the array) directly to err state. (4) MakerReviews.jsx:231 renders `

{err}

` — React explodes: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, url})'. Reproduction: open /makers/iron-and-oak#leave-review, fill name + text, click any star, leave Location blank, click Post Review → red runtime-error overlay appears, masking the page. Mitigation (frontend-only fix recommended, smaller blast radius): change line 109 to `location: form.location.trim()` (always send a string) AND in the catch on line 118 coerce: `const d = e?.response?.data?.detail; setErr(typeof d === 'string' ? d : (Array.isArray(d) && d[0]?.msg) || 'Failed to submit review. Please try again.')`.
